facts.summary: Strategic alternatives, 85% layoffs, NASH Phase 2b trial discontinued due to capital constraints · Phase 2 · AXA1125 in NASH/Long COVID · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The company has initiated a process to explore a range of strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value and is working with an investment bank to act as a strategic advisor for this process.
evidence.program_discontinued: Axcella will be discontinuing its ongoing Phase 2b clinical trial of AXA1125 in NASH, while keeping the option to revisit this program should resource availability change.
